correctness.rationale: Acyclic orientations of the graph are precisely independent transitive triangle orientations, giving 6^m. Under a Gaussian objective, coordinate ranks are exchangeable independent continuous uniforms after probability-integral transform. Condition on hub quantile u; each of two named leaf orders both below hub has mass u²/2, both above (1-u)²/2, and each straddling order u(1-u), with conditional triangle-block independence. Beta integral of (u²/2)^a((1-u)²/2)^b[u(1-u)]^c gives factorial angle; 2^m multinomial allocations give multiplicities. Condition on both independent hub quantiles u,v: six orientation label probability products sum to Q(u,v), so collision integral follows. Q=p(u) dot p(v)<=||p(u)||||p(v)||<=1/2, with equality only both u=v=0 or both =1; near either same corner Q=1/2-s-t+O((s+t)²). Two-dimensional boundary Laplace by m-rescaling and dominated convergence yields each corner 2^-m/(4m²), total 2^-m/(2m²). Test functions give equal corner mixture and independent rate-two exponentials. Independently counted every rank order for m=1,2,3 (3!,5!,7!) and exactly reproduced all cone frequencies and collision rationals 1/6,7/200,167/19600. This finite enumeration corroborates, not substitutes, the all-m asymptotic.
